text: Nice. now the next thing is i need you to survey all of the various authoring types we have used, and locate all the shapes we can add to our add just beyond a cube. also, for things like cylinder, the blockbench approach is perfect cylinder for example has diameter and height all the same, but then has sides. with a minimum of 3 and max of 48. this is exactly how our cylinder should work also
resolution: Shapes beyond the cube + Blockbench cylinder (req_1056). SURVEY: the only topological (editable) shape builders were cuboid + cylinder; the @reactjit/geometries registry has more (Sphere/Cone/Torus/Plane/Globe/Head/Heightfield/Humanoid/Carve/VoxelMesh) but those are render-only triangle soups that can't be loop-cut/extruded/rigged, so each Studio shape needs its own EditMesh builder. Added builders (all centered, all unwrapped at mint via fullFaceUV): cylinder reworked to Blockbench's knobs — diameter + height + a strict 'sides' count 3..48 (clampSides / SHAPE_SIDES_MIN/MAX); cone (n-side base ring tapering to one apex — the cylinder with its top ring collapsed); pyramid (axis-aligned square base to an apex — the cuboid with its 4 top verts collapsed, so it inherits the proven outward winding); plane (a single +Y quad). The Add Cube dialog became AddShapeDialog: a shape picker (Cube/Cylinder/Cone/Pyramid/Plane) with per-shape params (diameter always, height except plane, sides 3..48 for cylinder/cone) that builds the EditMesh and addParts it. editMesh 45/45 (+3 shape tests), modelStream 7/7, Studio + full workbench source chain bundle clean; hot-reload TSX, uncommitted. Surveyed follow-up shapes (heavier ring topology): sphere, torus, circle. PLAYBOOK Part 6 build log + memory updated.
